concerns.text: Task T013 (Gatekeeper pipeline) invokes the shared LLM backbone but provides no verification that the LLM runs successfully on a CPU‑only runner. FR‑003 explicitly requires CPU‑only execution; without a dedicated test (e.g., a unit test asserting `device='cpu'` and successful inference), the task risks violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and FR‑003.

Task T016 (Statistical analysis & correction) implements the GLMM and Holm‑Bonferroni correction but does not include a check that the GateMem dataset contains ≥ 100 episodes per domain, as required by the power analysis in FR‑005. Absence of this verification weakens the statistical validity claim and drops an acceptance criterion.
